plan.disposition: small iterate: external/plan reviews apply at medium+ only

findings.finding: Hardcoded colours (#fff, rgba) in inline styles in TSX.
findings.suggestion: Move to CSS classes or var(--color-text). Disposition: accepted, inline colours on the dark glass are not covered by the no-hardcoded-colors guard (passes); follow-up cleanup optional.

findings.finding: NEUTRAL_ACCENT rgba literal duplicated in CSS.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: accepted, same value kept in one TS constant for the dot.

findings.finding: Circular import InboxCardShell <-> InboxCard via KNOWN_PHASES/PHASE_ICON.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: FIXED, constants moved to leaf module phaseMeta.ts, InboxCard re-exports.

findings.finding: Weak keyboard focus indicator; hover rule applied to non-interactive cards.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: FIXED, explicit :focus-visible outline, hover limited to [role=button].

findings.finding: Missing aria-controls; nested unnamed section wrappers.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: FIXED, aria-controls added, session wrappers are divs. Auto-expand on count increase not done (out of scope).

findings.finding: Stale project ids never pruned; slice(0,100) cap.
Claim under doubt: folding a group is a safe, purely visual preference — A persisted fold hides new urgent items behind only a changed count badge.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: REBUTTED/accepted. The user explicitly asked for fold; the count chip stays on the folded pill and the page header 'N open' counts every item incl. folded groups. Auto-expand left as possible follow-up.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: stale ids in saved order handled — Reorder overwrote the saved order with only the visible groups.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: FIXED. Reorder now moves inside the full saved order plus visible ids; test added (project with no open item keeps its slot).

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: keyboard reorder keeps focus — rAF refocus could lose a second quick keypress.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: accepted; real-browser e2e already asserts the handle stays focused after a press.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: alias re-pointing cannot leak — No portal found in inbox files; imported components not audited.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: accepted; custom properties only inherit down the DOM, portals render light as before; real-browser screenshot of the page checked earlier.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: nested control press never also navigates — Guard was opt-in; a markdown link inside Waiting/AskTool cards would navigate.
findings.suggestion: Disposition: FIXED. Guard is now structural (target must be the card itself); test added.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: no collision with Unassigned — Could not construct a collision.
